24. 點 A 及點 B 的坐標分別為 (2,5) 及 (4,-1)。設 P 為直角坐標平面上的一動點使得 AP = BP。求 P 的軌跡的方程。
A. x - 3y + 3 = 0
B. x - 3y - 7 = 0
C. x - 3y + 13 = 0
D. 3x + y - 11 = 0
reasoning: The set of points equidistant from A and B is the perpendicular bisector of segment AB. The midpoint of AB is ((2+4)/2, (5+(-1))/2) = (3,2). The slope of AB is (-1-5)/(4-2) = -3, so the slope of the perpendicular bisector is 1/3. Using point-slope form with point (3,2): y - 2 = (1/3)(x - 3). Simplifying gives x - 3y + 3 = 0, which corresponds to option A.
